description: Regenerate lollipop figure (relative path) and emit final Weaver EZH2 variant CSV
code:
import requests, time, re
import matplotlib; matplotlib.use("Agg")
import matplotlib.pyplot as plt, matplotlib.patches as mpatches
import pandas as pd

def esearch(term):
    r=requests.get("https://eutils.ncbi.nlm.nih.gov/entrez/eutils/esearch.fcgi",
        params={"db":"clinvar","term":term,"retmax":2000,"retmode":"json"},timeout=40);time.sleep(0.34)
    return r.json()["esearchresult"]["idlist"]
def esummary(ids):
    out={}
    for i in range(0,len(ids),200):
        r=requests.get("https://eutils.ncbi.nlm.nih.gov/entrez/eutils/esummary.fcgi",
            params={"db":"clinvar","id":",".join(ids[i:i+200]),"retmode":"json"},timeout=60);time.sleep(0.34)
        out.update(r.json()["result"])
    return out
ids=esearch('EZH2[gene]'); summ=esummary(ids)
def parse_pos(n):
    m=re.search(r'p\.[A-Z][a-z]{2}(\d+)',n); return int(m.group(1)) if m else None
def classify(n):
    nm=n.lower()
    if "fs" in nm: return "frameshift"
    if "ter)" in nm or "*" in nm: return "nonsense"
    if "=" in nm: return "synonymous"
    if re.search(r'p\.[a-z]{3}\d+(del|dup|ins)',nm): return "inframe-indel"
    if "p." in nm: return "missense"
    return "noncoding/other"
rows=[]
for vid in ids:
    d=summ.get(vid,{})
    if not d: continue
    gc=d.get("germline_classification",{})
    rows.append(dict(vid=vid,name=d.get("title",""),
        germline=gc.get("description","") if isinstance(gc,dict) else "",
        traits=";".join(t.get("trait_name","") for t in gc.get("trait_set",[])) if isinstance(gc,dict) else "",
        cls=classify(d.get("title","")),pos=parse_pos(d.get("title",""))))
df=pd.DataFrame(rows)
plp=df[df.germline.str.contains("athogenic",na=False)&~df.germline.str.contains("Conflicting",na=False)]
weav=plp[plp.traits.str.contains("Weaver",case=False,na=False)].copy()
domains=[("SBD",1,105),("SANT1",159,257),("SANT2",428,476),("CXC",503,605),("SET",612,727),("post-SET",728,746)]
cols={"SBD":"#8dd3c7","SANT1":"#bebada","SANT2":"#fb8072","CXC":"#80b1d3","SET":"#fdb462","post-SET":"#ffed6f"}
mis=weav[weav.cls=="missense"].dropna(subset=["pos"]); trunc=weav[weav.cls.isin(["nonsense","frameshift"])].dropna(subset=["pos"])
fig,ax=plt.subplots(figsize=(11,3.2))
ax.add_patch(mpatches.Rectangle((1,-0.15),746,0.3,color="#e8e8e8"))
for n,s,e in domains:
    ax.add_patch(mpatches.Rectangle((s,-0.15),e-s,0.3,color=cols[n]))
    ax.text((s+e)/2,-0.42,n,ha="center",va="top",fontsize=7.5)
for _,r in mis.iterrows():
    ax.plot([r.pos,r.pos],[0.15,0.9],color="#333",lw=0.7); ax.plot(r.pos,0.95,"o",color="#1f78b4",ms=5)
for _,r in trunc.iterrows():
    ax.plot([r.pos,r.pos],[0.15,0.9],color="#e31a1c",lw=1.3); ax.plot(r.pos,0.95,"s",color="#e31a1c",ms=6)
ax.set_xlim(0,760);ax.set_ylim(-0.65,1.15);ax.set_yticks([])
ax.set_xlabel("EZH2 aa position (NM_004456.5, 746 aa)")
ax.set_title("Weaver pathogenic EZH2 variants: missense (blue) cluster in CXC/SET/post-SET; truncations (red) only C-terminal",fontsize=9)
ax.legend(handles=[mpatches.Patch(color="#1f78b4",label=f"missense n={len(mis)}"),
                   mpatches.Patch(color="#e31a1c",label=f"nonsense/fs n={len(trunc)}")],loc="upper left",fontsize=8)
plt.tight_layout(); plt.savefig("ezh2_weaver_lollipop.png",dpi=140)
print("figure saved; missense positions:",sorted(mis.pos.astype(int)))
print("truncation positions:",sorted(trunc.pos.astype(int)))
# fraction of missense in structured domains 132-158 or >=503
def structured(p): return (p<=257) or (p>=503)
print("missense in structured domains:",int(mis.pos.apply(structured).sum()),"/",len(mis))
print("=====CSV=====")
print(weav[["vid","name","cls","pos","germline","traits"]].sort_values(["cls","pos"]).to_csv(index=False))
